name: aco-agents
description: ACO — Art & Commerce Office: a context-first multi-office agent framework for creative practice, organizations, agencies, product work, legal workflows, recruitment, and durable work history.

interface.shortDescription: A modular office of specialist AI workflows.
interface.longDescription: ACO routes natural-language requests across specialist offices for artistic practice, cultural organizations, creative agencies, product/software, legal workflows, and recruitment. It can work statelessly or use a private knowledge layer such as a connected Google Drive, while keeping public agent logic separate from private context and history.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Concierge. Tell me what you want to achieve, and route the work through the right ACO office with the minimum relevant context.
